notes.title: Miaou Moon [1.05] Antigravity Belt
notes.content:
Version 1.05 Release Notes
Monday July 23rd, 2018

Hello,

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26014261/5b968f90ab5ae61f45b13e46cd691fcc1e4ec6da.png

A long due big patch to improve Miaou Moon!
Captain Miaou can now wear an Antigravity Belt and this changes everything!

This tool allows a better control over your trajectories.
Activate this belt at will to reduce your speed and gravity down to 0. Very useful when you need to fly back to the opposite direction or have to wait before continuing to move.
Even better: upgrade this belt to attract the food floating around!

Plus some nasty bugs were removed and the game speed improved.

Game Improvement:

Antigravity Belt: Activate with [space]
Game optimized to run at 60fps on all levels.
Vsync activated on all quality settings.


Game Balance:

Discovering all dead Astronauts grants an extra 9 points for your tools upgrades.
3 New Upgrades for the Antigravity Belt: raise range and power, and add food attraction.


UI changes:

Changing controls has to be done in the configuration window, before starting the game.
Added the [space] shortcut to activate your Antigravity belt.


Fixed bugs:
 
Dying in a level and using the available checkpoint will erase your dead spacionaut discovery.
Dead Spacionauts not registering well on some levels.
Menu settings not working.


Thanks all for your interest, happy gaming and thanks for your support!

notes.title: Miaou Moon [1.04] Dead Astronauts everywhere!
notes.content:
Version 1.04 Release Notes
Thurday, September 22rd, 2016
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26014261/eba88a053e01c96acf2a721b0ba2ac8b7ccf939a.jpg
Hey everyone,

A small patch to add informations about all dead astronauts on the Map screen : which level they are in and how many to find, in order to help you complete all achievements.

UI improvements:
Added dead astronauts symbols under each level in the Map screen.
This gives informations about the number of dead astronauts in each level, and how many are left to find.
The symbols are also highlighted each time you find and scratch a dead astronaut. This also shows how many you've credited for the Archeologist achievement. 



Thanks for your support and happy gaming!

notes.title: Miaou Moon [1.03] Leaderboards patch!
notes.content:
Version 1.03 Release Notes
Sunday, September 11rd, 2016
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26014261/c98fd268b00b3d1f3c2eedd6dd83225a408d6524.jpg

Hi everyone,

Get ready for competition: each levels and moons now have their own leaderboard! 
Stats are fixed and the first level's difficulty has been lowered for a smoother tutorial phase. 
Captain Miaou now shines a wider light from its catsuit, to improve your surroundings assessment. Plus, several graphic improvements, because cosmetics are always good ;)

Gameplay improvements:
Wider light system for better visibility.
Miaou Moon Steam Leaderboard is up!
Steam Leaderboards for each moons.
Steam Leaderboards for every levels.
Level 1-1 "Cloud zone" redesigned to lower the difficulty.
Level 1-11 "Wind zone" attraction angle modified in order to avoid being stuck.


Graphic improvements:
Improved Bee monsters graphics.
Improved Stars particles effect.
Changed Main menu background color.
Items picked and Use healing pack effect shaders are now unlit for a better visibility.


UI improvements:
Map screen now displays Total score for each moon and Total score for the whole game.
Rate yourself against the Highest Steam leaderboard score displayed on the map screen.
Personal High score and Highest Steam leaderboard score are displayed once you finish a level.
Added a confirmation window when trying to quit the game.


Bug Fixed:
Fixed score raised to +5 when using a Health pack (hotkey [H]).
Fixed Level 4-4 missing a camera.
Fixed an internal error where you would enter a level with every power cell already found.
Fixed Checkpoint option still showing when you died, without a Checkpoint activated.
Fixed small lasers acting like a solid barrier.


Thanks for your support and happy gaming!

notes.title: Miaou Moon [1.02] Localization n graphics patch!
notes.content:
Version 1.02 Release Notes
Saturday, September 3rd, 2016

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26014261/fdedd34cf4088ab6ba40d2db0dbb2c91f188467d.png

Hi everyone!

Good news: you now start the game with a Free Upgrade available!

Miaou Moon is now localized in Spanish and Russian. 
We also improved the graphic quality of the game with smoother animation transitions, some sprites have been redrawn and many graphic effects have been added.

Gameplay improvements:
Game starts with 3 tools available, which give 1 free Upgrade.
The suit capacity can now be upgraded up to level 6.
Easier access to the first cloud on level 1.1., makes it easier to scratch.
Added energy food on level 1.1.
Added energy food on level 1.7.
Dead monsters and scratched astronauts now disappear faster.


UI Improvements:
Text localized in Spanish.
Text localized in Russian.
The "New level" indicator now stays visible until you visit the level.
The Checkpoint option only appears in the menu when a Checkpoint has been activated.
Edited some Help texts.


Graphic improvements:
Smoother animations transitions.
Added dust effects when Captain Miaou hits the moon surface and slides on it.
Added animated effects when collecting Energy Cells, Tools and Healing pack.
Added animated effects when using a Healing pack (hotkey [H] ).



Thanks for your support and happy gaming!

notes.title: Miaou Moon [1.01] 1st patch
notes.content:
Version 1.01 Release Notes
Monday, August 22th, 2016

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26014261/63216585fee4df362bf030421577c5e61ff3d186.jpg

Hi everyone!

Our first patch is up, with improved animations on Captain Miaou.
We also reduced the requirements needed to reach the next moon.

Game balance:
Number of energy cells required to jump over the next moon reduced to 20 (instead of 30).
Flying food no longer breaks your speed momentum, unless it has extreme speed.

Graphic improvements:
Reworked some of the cat animations.
Captain Miaou now blinks eyes during its normal state.

Fixed bugs:
Fixed the wrong stance that was sometimes applied when you won a level.


Thanks for your support and happy gaming!
